name: Registro.br (RDAP, availability, public lists)
operator: NIC.br (Nucleo de Informacao e Coordenacao do Ponto BR) - Registro.br
tier_rationale: NIC.br / Registro.br, the .br registry and Brazilian NIR (A8 definitions: internet registries, 'NIC.br/registro.br', are trusted); P005 'NIC.br, trusted', P038 'NIC.br public registry data: tier trusted' (P003/P021's community tier is rdap.org's/BrasilAPI's).

reliability.justification: Authoritative registry data for .br names and Brazilian IP/ASN space (registrant CNPJ, dates, availability, release process).

rdap.title: Registro.br RDAP (domain, entity, ip, autnum)

terms.quote: registro.br RDAP is default-on by decision (A3 BR9). Tier community because rdap.org, a volunteer redirector, receives values on fallback; registries are trusted. Terms open (public registry data).

rdap.notes: Quote: council chair rationale (P003). rdap.registro.br/domain|entity|ip|autnum (research C0544, C0089). Observed 2026-11-26 in the RDAP notices ('Use and Privacy Policy', link = evidence_url): 'Use of this data is governed by the Use and Privacy Policy. Distribution, commercialization, reproduction, and use for advertising or similar purposes are expressly prohibited.' Per-query lookups only, no bulk harvesting; natural-person data dropped at ingestion, CPF never stored (P003). 403/429/timeouts = BLOCKED/RATE_LIMITED, never cached.

avail.title: Registro.br domain availability API /v2/ajax/avail/raw/{domain}

terms.quote: Tier community because BrasilAPI receives the name on fallback; registro.br is trusted. Terms open (public registry service, MIT community API).

avail.notes: Quote: council chair rationale (P021). registro.br/v2/ajax/avail/raw/{domain} (research C0051): individual .br names only, at most 20 per run, min_interval >= 5 s and cache 24 h at module level, never a bulk checker for typosquat permutations (P021, registro.br anti-abuse terms); the module sets its own Accept for this JSON.

release_list.title: Registro.br domains-in-release list /dominio/lista-processo-liberacao.txt

terms.quote: the registro.br release list lista-processo-liberacao.txt (open; NIC.br, trusted). Lists are never redistributed.

release_list.notes: Quote: binding council text (P005 cond 1). registro.br/dominio/lista-processo-liberacao.txt (research C0038; ISO-8859-1, '#' comments, weekly cycle) through the dataset manager; hits are tagged in_release (P005).

asn_blocks.title: NIC.br ASN block list /pub/numeracao/origin/nicbr-asn-blk-latest.txt

terms.quote: NIC.br public registry data: tier trusted, terms open.

asn_blocks.notes: Quote: council chair rationale (P038). ftp.registro.br/pub/numeracao/origin/nicbr-asn-blk-latest.txt (research C0088) as a daily dataset: stale copy kept on failure, a missing dataset = could not verify (P038).

whois_web.title: Registro.br web whois (manual link when RDAP is blocked)

terms.quote: 403/429/timeouts give BLOCKED/RATE_LIMITED 'could not verify' (never cached, so the next scan retries) and emit the registro.br web whois as manual_link.

whois_web.notes: Quote: binding council text (P003 cond 2). Manual link to the registro.br web whois when RDAP is blocked. V3LUM never fetches pivot links itself (P311).

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G01-1, p1-G02-1, p2-G01-1, p3-G01-1, p9-G01-1: batches only extend it (registrobr__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). One provider: one operator with shared per-IP limits. BINDING PROFILE_REQUIREMENTS (registro.br, rdap.registro.br): user_agent neutral, Accept application/rdap+json, Accept-Language pt-BR, ttl <= 86400; the profile applies to every host, so modules set Accept themselves for the avail JSON and the text lists. Per-IP limits are unpublished (from a datacenter egress 1 of 5 RDAP attempts answered, the others 403; research C0544): min_interval 1 s floor, no quota block (no figure).
